in_sanskrit.name: सन्दीप्रज
in_sanskrit.meaning: illumining, enlightening, radiant, shining, brilliant, splendid, lord of light
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सन्दीप (sandīp) - illumining, enlightening, radiant, shining, brilliant, splendid, lord of light + रज (raj) - lord, ruler

in_hindi.name: सन्दीप्रज
in_hindi.meaning: संदीप (sandīp) - अलग्राहक तेज (algrāhak tej) - illumining, enlightening, radiant, shining, brilliant, splendid, lord of light + राज (rāj) - राजा (rājā) - king, ruler, lord
in_hindi.long_meaning: सन्दीप (sandīp) - अलग्राहक (algrāhak) - illumining, enlightening, radiant, shining, brilliant, splendid + तेज (tej) - तेजस्विन् (tejasvin) - radiant, shining, brilliant + राज (rāj) - राजा (rājā) - king, ruler, lord

in_tamil.name: சந்தீப்ராஜ்
in_tamil.meaning: தமிழ் அல்வார் (tamiḻ alvār) - enlightening, illumining + ராஜ (rāj) - இளம்பரம் (iḻambaram) - king, ruler, lord
in_tamil.long_meaning: சந்தீபம் (sandīpam) - அல்வார் (alvār) - enlightening, illumining + ராஜா (rājā) - இளம்பரம் (iḻambaram) - king, ruler, lord

in_telugu.name: సందీప్రాజ్
in_telugu.meaning: శూద్ధముద్దేశ్వరపు (śūddhamuddesvarapu) - pure, clean, excellent, best, master, ruler, lord of the universe, supreme god
in_telugu.long_meaning: సోదేశ (sōdēśa) - excellent, best + దీప (dīpam) - lamp, light + రాజ (rāj) - రాజపు (rājapu) - king, ruler, lord

in_marathi.name: Sandeepraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sandeepraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sandeepraj is composed of two words, 'Sandeep' meaning 'deep' and 'Raj' meaning 'rule'. The name signifies one who rules from the depths of his consciousness.
